builds.author: Agnoxia
builds.description:
**Role**: Initiator/Puller in group content. He is one of the best at leading group fights, gathering enemies and coordinating engages.

**Strategy for use**
* **Pre-engage**: You can use the W (Shoulder Charge) or boots to bait enemy defenders (you pretend you're going in and don't).
* **Real Engage**: Once they've spent defensives, you do Boots + E to drag several enemies towards your team.
* **Clap**: Your team unleashes all the damage at the spot where you gathered the enemies.
* **Escape/Re-engage**: Use the assassin's hood to reset E and be ready for a second clap.

builds.description:
To start, **NO**, don’t use reduced cast time passives on your armor — it doesn’t work like you think it does. You get **Speed Buffs** from specific items like **Morgana Cape**, **Passive 3** on your weapon, and **Speed Caster** from **Scholar Robe**. Otherwise, focus on **all damage passives**. If you think you need more speed, you're not playing it right, period.  

You also get a **speed buff** from your **Omelette**.  

**How to play Perma:**  
1. Use **Glacial Obelisk** to buff your team.  
2. Before dropping your abilities, do **R > E > QQQQQQQQQQ**.  

Simple.

​👤 Build Concept & Philosophy
​The golden rule of this set is strict budget management.
​High Budget / Confident Play: If you have enough silver and can comfortably afford at least 2–3 backup sets, go for the expensive, high-damage option. You must be confident in your PvP skills and play without fear.
​Low Budget / Eco Play: If these are your last resources, going out in expensive gear is a mistake. Fear of losing your items will cause you to choke and misplay during a fight. In this case, the build switches to a cheaper variant focused on survivability and sustain.
​

The **Shadowcaller Support build** is designed as a **reset-piercer**.  

- Drop **E & W together** to **shred enemy damage resistance** and use **Cursed Tar** for extra damage.  
- When enemies drop **below 50%**, stack **Mortal Agony, Cultist Sandals, E, and W** to burst them down.

builds.title: SUPRISE! THUNDER GOD IS HERE
builds.author: BullackFlames
builds.description:
Use Invis potion. Get close to the enemy then use ray of light (W) followed up with raging storm (E).
Immediately after, use Ballista support fire (D)
Keep using Q and basic attacks. 
Enemy should be dead or be dangling by the skin of their teeth.
